name: get0
title: Look up a name, or return a default

origin.description: Like mget of one name. A missing name returns ifnotfound.
origin.usage: get0(x, envir = pos.to.env(-1L), mode = "any", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = NULL)

arguments.name: envir
arguments.text: A dict. The caller is used when this is omitted.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.text: any, numeric, character, logical, or function.

arguments.name: inherits
arguments.text: When envir is omitted, also search the caller globals.

arguments.name: ifnotfound
arguments.text: Returned when the name is missing or the mode does not match.

origin.details: On this R, a name longer than one element is an error. The default environment is the caller. The check passes a dictionary.
origin.example:
bp_get0 <- getFromNamespace("get0", "backports")
e <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
e$foo <- 12
print(bp_get0("a", envir = e, ifnotfound = 0))
print(bp_get0("foo", envir = e))
